recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-3218 unless a future work-group issue requests a new datatype navigation design.
issue_request: FHIR-3218 asked that datatypes use the same multi-tab approach as resources, with separate tabs for the main datatype page, examples, definitions, mappings, profiles, and similar pages rather than multiple loose links from one page.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as done in SVN revisions 3016 and 3017. In git history, those are 0652011d547371a2206472b5de0d245996ed232a and cef4f70fb1262eb6c9fc645cab346eb23f1e4231, both titled "Task 3218: standardise tab use in core documentation" and affecting core documentation pages and publisher tab/header machinery.
additional_context: Current source/hierarchy.xml nests Datatypes with Examples, Detailed Descriptions, Mappings, Profiles, and MetaData Types pages; publish.ini actively includes the datatype pages; and datatype tab source pages invoke the dtheader macro. A later 2023 source reorganization kept and expanded the datatype tab family for IG packaging. Zulip and Confluence searches found no later conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source files were edited because current build-scoped source and current CI output already provide the requested datatype tabbed navigation.
